about.title: About SSL Group
about.description: SSL Group is a trusted exporter of high-quality Metallurgical products serving global markets with reliability and excellence
about.description1: For over two decades, SSL Group has supplied the global steel industry with export-grade pig iron, ferro alloys, carbon products, and industrial minerals. Our integrated sourcing, bonded warehousing, and port-side logistics deliver the consistency that enterprise procurement demands.
about.description2: From Middle East steel giants to African foundries and European distributors, we are the single-window partner for metallurgical raw material excellence.
about.Title: Forging Global Metallurgy Partnerships
about.SSLGroup: Since 2018, SSL Group has grown from a Delhi trading house into a premier international exporter of steel industry raw materials — trusted by manufacturers across 45+ countries.
about.Documentation: We exist to bridge the gap between India`s world-class metallurgical production capacity and the global steel industry`s demand for reliable, export-grade raw materials. Every shipment reflects our commitment to quality, documentation, and long-term partnership.
about.Globals: Connecting Indian Metallurgy to the World
about.OurTeam: Our team of metallurgists, trade specialists, and logistics coordinators work as an extension of your procurement department — from specification review to port delivery.

PigIron.Name: Pig Iron
PigIron.ShortDescription: Foundry and steel-grade pig iron with controlled silicon and sulfur for blast furnace and casting applications.
PigIron.Description: SSL Group exports premium foundry and basic pig iron sourced from ISO-certified integrated steel plants.

FoundryGradePigIron.Name: Foundry Grade Pig Iron
FoundryGradePigIron.Description: Foundry Grade Pig Iron is used in the production of grey iron castings, ductile iron, and malleable iron. It has controlled silicon and sulfur content for optimal casting properties.

PhysicalPropertiesRows.StoreDryCoveredArea: Store in a dry and covered area

FAQ.WhatIsFoundryPigIronAnswer: Foundry Pig Iron is a high-quality raw material used in the production of grey iron castings. It offers excellent fluidity, machinability, and consistent chemical composition for foundry applications.
FAQ.GradesQuestion: What grades of Foundry Pig Iron do you supply?
FAQ.GradesAnswer: We supply various Foundry Pig Iron grades, including L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, L6, and L5–L6 Low Mn, based on customer requirements.
FAQ.ApplicationsQuestion: What are the applications of Foundry Pig Iron?
FAQ.ApplicationsAnswer: Foundry Pig Iron is widely used for manufacturing grey iron castings, automotive components, machine parts, pipes, manhole covers, agricultural equipment, and engineering castings.
FAQ.PackingAnswer: The product is supplied in loose bulk, palletized loads, or 1 MT jumbo bags, depending on customer and export requirements.
FAQ.CustomizedQuestion: Can you provide customized grades and specifications?
FAQ.CustomizedAnswer: Yes. We can supply different Foundry Pig Iron grades and specifications according to customer requirements and applicable industry standards.
FAQ.ExportQuestion: Do you export Foundry Pig Iron internationally?
FAQ.ExportAnswer: Yes. We supply and export Foundry Pig Iron to domestic and international markets with reliable sourcing, quality assurance, and timely delivery.

BasicGradePigIron.Name: Basic Grade Pig Iron
BasicGradePigIron.Description: Basic Grade Pig Iron is primarily used in steelmaking, electric arc furnaces, induction furnaces, and steel foundries. It has low silicon content and controlled phosphorus and sulfur levels for efficient steel production.

PhysicalPropertiesRows.StoreDryCoveredArea: Store in a dry and covered area

FAQ.WhatIsBasicPigIronQuestion: What is Basic Grade Pig Iron?
FAQ.WhatIsBasicPigIronAnswer: Basic Grade Pig Iron is a high-quality iron product mainly used as a raw material in steelmaking and foundry applications. It contains low silicon and controlled phosphorus and sulfur levels.
FAQ.GradesQuestion: What grades of Basic Grade Pig Iron do you supply?
FAQ.GradesAnswer: We supply Basic Grade Pig Iron in different chemical compositions based on customer specifications and applicable industry standards.
FAQ.ApplicationsQuestion: What are the applications of Basic Grade Pig Iron?
FAQ.ApplicationsAnswer: Basic Grade Pig Iron is widely used in steel plants, electric arc furnaces, induction furnaces, alloy steel production, and engineering industries.
FAQ.PackingAnswer: The product is supplied in loose bulk, palletized loads, or 1 MT jumbo bags according to customer and export requirements.
FAQ.CustomizedQuestion: Can you provide customized grades and specifications?
FAQ.CustomizedAnswer: Yes. We can supply customized Basic Grade Pig Iron grades and chemical compositions according to customer requirements.
FAQ.ExportQuestion: Do you export Basic Grade Pig Iron internationally?
FAQ.ExportAnswer: Yes. We export Basic Grade Pig Iron to customers worldwide with consistent quality, reliable sourcing, and timely delivery.

SteelGradePigIron.Name: Steel Grade Pig Iron
SteelGradePigIron.Description: Steel Grade Pig Iron is a premium raw material used in steelmaking through electric arc furnaces, induction furnaces, and basic oxygen furnaces. It provides controlled chemistry, low impurities, and excellent melting performance for high-quality steel production.

PhysicalPropertiesRows.StoreDryCoveredArea: Store in a dry and covered area

FAQ.WhatIsSteelPigIronQuestion: What is Steel Grade Pig Iron?
FAQ.WhatIsSteelPigIronAnswer: Steel Grade Pig Iron is a high-quality pig iron used primarily as a raw material in steel production. It offers controlled silicon, phosphorus, and sulfur levels to ensure consistent steel quality.
FAQ.GradesQuestion: What grades of Steel Grade Pig Iron do you supply?

NodularPigIron.Name: Nodular Pig Iron
NodularPigIron.Description: Nodular Pig Iron is specially manufactured for producing ductile (SG) iron castings. It features low sulfur, controlled phosphorus, and optimized silicon content to ensure superior nodularity, strength, and machinability.
